facts.text: The mission script imports mavros_msgs State, CommandBool, SetMode and CommandTOL and geometry_msgs PoseStamped.
The mission script subscribes /mavros/state as State and /mavros/local_position/pose as PoseStamped with BEST_EFFORT, VOLATILE, KEEP_LAST depth 10.
The mission script publishes /mavros/setpoint_position/local as PoseStamped at 20 Hz for the requested duration and then returns True without checking the final position.
The mission script creates clients for /mavros/cmd/arming CommandBool, /mavros/set_mode SetMode and /mavros/cmd/takeoff CommandTOL.
set_mode maps the mode string to custom_mode and treats the SetMode mode_sent response as success.
arm sends value = true and checks the CommandBool success response.
takeoff sets altitude and checks the CommandTOL success response, logging only that the command was sent.
Altitude attainment is a separate observation loop over /mavros/local_position/pose with a 0.3 m default tolerance.
The demo mission sets GUIDED, arms, requests 10.0 m takeoff, moves to (10.0, 0.0, 10.0) for 15 s and requests RTL; these are demo targets, not safe envelopes.
The SITL guide documents a LAND request on /mavros/set_mode with mavros_msgs/srv/SetMode and custom_mode LAND.
The hardware guide's kill switch is an RC transmitter procedure: switch to manual mode, disarm via RC switch and emergency land.
The hardware guide requires propellers to be removed and the drone secured for bench testing, because motors can spin when armed.
The hardware guide's in-flight emergency procedure is manual RC control (STABILIZE) and a manual landing, not a ROS stop service.
The hardware guide states that the same mission scripts used in SITL work on real hardware.
The SITL MAVROS configuration sets the setpoint_position frame to map and the setpoint_velocity MAV frame to LOCAL_NED, and allowlists the setpoint_position and setpoint_velocity plugins.
The real-hardware launch defaults fcu_url to /dev/ttyACM0:921600 and starts the external mavros_node with target system/component id 1.
The SITL launch defaults fcu_url to udp://:14550@ and starts the external mavros_node with target system/component id 1.
